About the author

Ian Duncan MacDonald Ian's first job after graduating from McMaster University was as a commercial credit reporter with Dun & Bradstreet. They employed 8,000 people in offices around the world. Each day he was sent out to investigate eleven businesses. His reports were requested by banks, insurance companies, manufacturers, and wholesalers. They could enquire on the smallest to the largest of businesses. Being naturally curious, Ian loved the job. At twenty-three years of age, he could walk into any business and ask their chief executive how they operated and made money. Ian quickly acquired a wealth of business knowledge. He progressed very rapidly through the company as a reporting manager, sales representative.
